basic_info.description: Welcome to Viewpoint at the Ridge, a peaceful retreat just 10 minutes from SF and South San Francisco's biotech hub. Nestled along the slopes of San Bruno Mountain in a coveted cul-de-sac, this corner unit townhome-style condo offers a rare mix of natural beauty, modern comfort & an unbeatable location. Inside, you will find high ceilings, fresh paint, wood & tile flooring & an open layout gleaming with natural light. The living & dining areas flow seamlessly to a spacious covered balcony great for entertaining or relaxing with unobstructed views of the bay. A cozy gas fireplace adds warmth & charm. The freshly painted white kitchen features abundant cabinetry enhanced by SS appliances & a breakfast bar. The large primary suite includes an oversized walk-in closet, dual-sink vanity & a second private balcony. A full guest bath & a secondary bedroom is ideal for guests, office space or children. This picture-perfect home features a laundry room & a private 2-car garage with ample space for parking & storage. Enjoy access to resort-style amenities: gym, spa, clubhouse, playground & more. Discover the perfect blend of comfort & convenience. A must-see opportunity for anyone seeking the best of Bay Area living. The Viewpoint at The Ridge is more than just a home, its a lifestyle.
